title: Fibonacci EA v5.0 Deep Retracement (Fib 78.6%) Test
research_question: Does enabling the deep 78.6% Fibonacci retracement level (InpUseFib786 = true) with RSI extreme filter (<=42 bull / >=58 bear) capture high-probability reversal entries and increase total net profit above baseline EXP-0008 ($577.65) while maintaining max equity drawdown <= 8.0% on GBPUSD M15?
hypothesis: Enabling the 78.6% Fibonacci retracement level will unlock deep pullback entries with favorable risk-to-reward ratios without compromising the overall 79% win rate, resulting in higher trade count and net profit exceeding the baseline $577.65 while keeping maximum equity drawdown within the 8.0% prop firm threshold.

facts: EXP-0008 achieved $577.65 net profit, 1.39 profit factor, 79.38% win rate, and 7.35% max equity drawdown with InpDirection=2 and Fib levels 38.2%, 50.0%, 61.8% active.

In the EA source logic, Fib 78.6% entries require stricter RSI extreme filters (RSI <= 42 for bull, RSI >= 58 for bear) compared to 61.8% (RSI <= 62 bull / >= 38 bear), preventing entries during momentum blowouts.
inferences: Deep 78.6% pullbacks offer natural support/resistance confluence near swing boundaries, allowing the 15-pip SL to sit safely beyond swing extremes.
Activating this level should capture valid reversal moves that currently overshoot 61.8% without triggering false breakouts.

independent_variables.name: InpUseFib786
independent_variables.rationale: Enable the deep 78.6% Fibonacci retracement tier to capture extreme pullback opportunities with RSI extreme confirmation.

assumptions: Historical tick quality of 99% remains consistent across the test period.
RSI extreme condition (<=42 / >=58) provides adequate filtering for 78.6% level.
expected_observations: Total trades will increase from 272 to at least 285.
Total net profit will exceed the baseline $577.65.
falsification_conditions: Total net profit drops below baseline $577.65.
Maximum equity drawdown exceeds 8.0%, breaching the prop firm guard.
